maddeler.e:
احتقرن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَرْنَ (iḥtaqarna) /iħ.ta.qar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# اُحْتُقِرْنَ (uḥtuqirna) /uħ.tu.qir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# اِحْتَقِرْنَ (iḥtaqirna) /iħ.ta.qir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
